items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: One of my drum students, Tom Harden, who was in the percussion section said, “man that guy set such an energy level.”

ctx.x: One of my drum students, Tom Harden, who was in the percussion section said, “man that guy set such an energy level.”

Well I used to do a, thank you very much, I used to do a number of things, I tried to be original, with Brubeck, but as you know, every single night we would sooner or later we’d have to close with “Take Five.” They just would not let him out of town without playing “Take Five,” and so that was my big moment and I used to do small little pockets of tributes to Joe Morello, and throw some of those in there.
